title: Clarification answer
description: DEC-2026-10-18, derived from the clarification it answers (clarification.v1.json): the base fields every object carries plus clarification_id, and 'answers', a map from each slot name the clarification requested to a value that validates against that slot's type in the Intent Object schema (intent-slot.v1.json). Unknown slot names are rejected: this schema checks the shape (a slot name, a typed slot value); that every key is a slot the clarification requested is checked against the clarification itself by tools/contracts/validate.py and by core when it binds the answer (REQ-AMB-005). No other field is defined. Only the authenticated principal may answer (identity comes from the session, never from this object).
